title: Claude Opus 5.5 sessions are priced as Claude Opus 5, at more than twice their real cost
foundBy: session agent, auditing `pricing.json` against the provider price pages fetched on 2026-09-29; filed at the host's request: "file ledger entries in the tracer repo to report any issues with the pricing"
details:
`pricing.json` has no entry for `claude-opus-5-5`. A model name is matched by the longest table key it contains, so Opus 5.5 falls to the `claude-opus-5` entry.

The provider's price page, fetched on 2026-09-29, lists Opus 5.5 at $4 input and $20 output per million tokens. Its 5-minute and 1-hour cache writes cost $5 and $8, and its cache reads $0.20. Those are 0.8 times the Opus 5 rates, except cache reads, which Opus 5.5 prices at 0.05 times base input rather than 0.1. Fast mode is $8 input and $40 output, where Opus 5 charges $10 and $50.

Cache reads are most of a long agentic session, so the error is most of the estimate. On one host, six trajectories on Opus 5.5 held 658 million tokens. The estimate for them is $398, and their list price is $188.

Some Claude Code records name the model `claude-opus-5-5[1m]`, which a `claude-opus-5-5` key also matches.

The fix is a `claude-opus-5-5` entry with those rates, a fast mode at $8 and $40 with the cache multipliers on top, and the US multiplier. TRC-006 was the same fault on Claude Fable 5.1.
